clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1. Scope—Material and performance equirements for chemically resistant glazed stoneware pipes (straight pipes) and fittings    (taper pipes; bends, taper bends; junctions; half section channels; straight and taper ; channel junctions; channel bends; channel interceptors; gully traps and inspection pipes). Dimensions of chemically resistant glazed stoneware pipes and fittings are grouped into two sections, A and B. Section A covers dimensions of straight pipes and all such fittings which normally form a part of a pipe line and which are subject to the same conditions, specifications and tests as straight pipes. Section B includes dimensions of fittings which are commonly used and which do no form a part of the normal pipe line. The fittings in Section B being hand-moulded, their conformity to dimensional specifications is not required to be so accurate as for those in Section A.

clauses.title: Shall be sound and
clauses.text: 2.1 Shall be sound and free from visible defects, such as, cracks, crazing, etc.

clauses.title: Shall give sharp clear
clauses.text: 2.2 Shall give sharp clear note when struck with light hammer.

clauses.title: Interior and exterior surfaces
clauses.text: 2.3 Interior and exterior surfaces of the pipes and fittings which remain exposed after jointing, shall be glazed.

clauses.title: Pipes shall withstand hydraulic
clauses.text: 3.1 Pipes shall withstand hydraulic pressure of 0.3 MPa on the barrels and 0.15 MPa on fittings. The pressure shall be maintained for not less than 5 seconds without showing signs of leakage or injury.

clauses.title: Water absorption shall not exceed the following
clauses.text: 3.2 Water absorption shall not exceed the following : Thickness of Pipe or Increase in Mass, Fitting Percent Up to 20 mm 3 20 to 25 mm
